abstract: A 22-year-old man with a history of left radical orchiectomy due to a testicular tumor had bilateral pulmonary tumors. Transbronchial biopsy specimens revealed them to be germ cell tumors. The serum levels of AFP and hCG-beta were elevated. The right testis was free from a palpable mass but showed a small hyperechoic lesion on scrotal ultrasonography. We excised the echogenic focus, which was a whitish nodule under the tunica albuginea. By pathological findings it was diagnosed as a burned-out testicular tumor. This was a case with metachronous bilateral testicular tumors.
abstract_ja: 左精巣腫瘍のため根治的精巣摘除術を受けた既往のある22歳男性が、両側肺腫瘍を有していた。経気管支生検標本で胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびβ-hCGが上昇していた。右精巣には触知可能な腫瘤はなかったが、陰嚢超音波検査で小さな高エコー性病変を認めた。白膜下の白色結節を切除し、病理学的にburned-out型精巣腫瘍と診断された。これは異時性両側精巣腫瘍の症例である。
